title: Solution Architect - Full Stack
description:
We are seeking an experienced and highly skilled Solution Architect with expertise in Node.js, React, Next.js, and Nest.js. The ideal candidate will be responsible for architecting scalable, secure, and high-performing cloud solutions on Microsoft Azure, with a focus on Azure Functions, PostgreSQL, Elasticsearch, and system integrations. This role requires collaboration with cross-functional teams, translating business requirements into effective technical solutions. 
 Key Responsibilities: 
 1. Solution Design and Architecture: Design and architect scalable and reliable cloud solutions on Microsoft Azure. Develop architecture blueprints, technical design documents, and implementation plans. Ensure solutions are aligned with enterprise architecture standards and best practices. 
 2. Node.js, React, Next.js, and Nest.js Development: Lead and participate in the development of applications and services using Node.js, React, Next.js, and Nest.js. Optimize applications for maximum performance and scalability. Ensure code quality and maintainability through code reviews and adherence to coding standards. 
 3. Cloud Integration and Deployment: Design and implement CI/CD pipelines for automated deployment and testing. Utilize Azure DevOps for source control, build, release management, and monitoring. Implement and manage Azure services such as Azure Functions, App Services, and more. 
 4. Database Management: Design and manage PostgreSQL databases to ensure high availability and performance. Implement and manage data indexing and search capabilities using Elasticsearch. Ensure data integrity, security, and compliance. 
 5. Security and Compliance: Ensure solutions adhere to security best practices and compliance requirements. Implement identity and access management solutions. 
 6. System Integrations: Design and implement integrations with third-party systems and services. Ensure seamless data flow and interoperability between different components. Troubleshoot and resolve integration issues. 
 7. Collaboration and Communication: Work closely with stakeholders to gather requirements and provide technical guidance. Collaborate with development, operations, and other teams to ensure seamless integration and delivery. Communicate complex technical concepts to non-technical stakeholders effectively. 
 8. Performance Monitoring and Optimization: Monitor the performance and health of cloud-based applications and infrastructure. Troubleshoot and resolve performance issues and other technical challenges. Continuously improve and optimize cloud solutions for better performance and cost-efficiency. 
 Qualifications: 
 Experience Minimum of 10 years of experience in software development, with at least 2 -3 years in Node.js, React, Next.js, and Nest.js. Proven experience in designing and implementing solutions on Microsoft Azure. Strong experience with cloud architecture, PaaS and DevOps practices. 
 Technical Skills Proficiency in Node.js, React, Next.js, Nest.js, and JavaScript/TypeScript. Strong knowledge of Azure services (e.g., Azure Functions, App Services, etc.). Experience with PostgreSQL and Elasticsearch. Experience with containerization technologies such as Docker. Familiarity with infrastructure-as-code tools like Terraform. Understanding of networking, security, and identity management in Azure. Experience with CI/CD tools and practices, especially Azure DevOps. 
 Soft Skills Excellent problem-solving and analytical skills. Strong communication and interpersonal skills. Ability to work independently and as part of a team. Detail-oriented and highly organized.

And we re counting on your unique voice and perspective to help EY become even better, too. Join us and build an exceptional experience for yourself, and a better working world for all. AI Data Protection Forward Deployed Engineer - Manager Role summary We are looking for an AI Data Protection Forward Deployed Engineer - Manager to act as the technical owner for client-facing data protection transformations that sit at the intersection of enterprise platforms, cybersecurity controls, and AI tools. This role is for a hands-on leader who can move from discovery to design to deployment, embedding closely with clients to architect and implement high-impact solutions while leading engineering teams and shaping deals. Your internal role matrix positions this level as the next step beyond field/staff engineering: not just delivery, but architecting solutions at the intersection of platforms and AI tools (agents and models). That aligns closely with external FDE market patterns focused on customer-embedded technical ownership and end-to-end production deployment. Key responsibilities Lead the discovery, architecture, and deployment of AI-enabled data protection solutions for strategic clients, translating business, privacy, and cybersecurity requirements into scalable technical designs. Serve as a forward deployed technical leader, embedding with client stakeholders to break down ambiguous problem statements, make architecture decisions, and drive measurable outcomes in production. External FDE role definitions from EY, Databricks, Palantir, and Deloitte all emphasize this embedded technical ownership model. Architect integrations across data protection platforms, AI models, copilots, RAG pipelines, enterprise data estates, and downstream security/policy controls. Lead engineering teams through build, integration, testing, troubleshooting, go-live, and post-deployment hardening while maintaining delivery quality, client confidence, and practical execution pace. Shape pursuit solutions through demonstrations, solution architecture, proofs of concept, effort estimates, and technical proposals. This is explicitly called out in external FDE manager patterns. Build reusable methods, accelerators, reference architectures, and runbooks that strengthen the firm s AI data protection offerings and improve repeatability across sectors and accounts. Manage client expectations, delivery scope, solution quality, risks, and technical escalations while coaching teams and enabling long-term client capability through documentation and knowledge transfer. Required qualifications 8-12 years of experience across data protection, cybersecurity engineering, security architecture, privacy engineering, cloud security, or related fields. Strong depth in data protection, data discovery/classification, PKI & KMS, and information rights management. Strong working knowledge of ML, deep learning, NLP, RAG, AI-assisted prioritization, and model risk scoring, with experience applying these to enterprise problem-solving. Demonstrated experience designing and deploying enterprise-grade solutions across cloud and hybrid environments, ideally on Azure, AWS, or GCP. Comparable FDE manager roles consistently require cloud-native delivery, APIs, and production systems ownership. Hands-on experience with AI/data protection tooling such as Microsoft Copilot, GitHub Copilot, Claude Enterprise, Gemini Enterprise, Purview, DSPM platforms, Python, and related enterprise engineering tools. Strong client-facing communication and the ability to operate as a trusted technical advisor to senior stakeholders. Preferred qualifications Experience in a professional services, solutions engineering, field engineering, or forward deployed model. Familiarity with regulated sectors such as financial services, healthcare, public sector, or large multinational enterprises. External senior digital trust/privacy FDE roles explicitly value regulated-industry depth. Experience with pricing inputs, solution estimation, and technical deal shaping. Why join us Join a globally connected cybersecurity practice helping clients protect sensitive data in an AI-driven world. You will work at the intersection of data protection, privacy, cloud, and frontier AI - helping shape practical, scalable solutions that reduce risk, enable trust, and support secure business transformation. This is consistent with the internal positioning of the data protection practice as technology-enabled, consulting-led, and globally delivered. title: Sr HR Analyst
description:
Our Purpose Mastercard powers economies and empowers people in 200+ countries and territories worldwide. Together with our customers, we re helping build a sustainable economy where everyone can prosper. We support a wide range of digital payments choices, making transactions secure, simple, smart and accessible. Our technology and innovation, partnerships and networks combine to deliver a unique set of products and services that help people, businesses and governments realize their greatest potential. Title and Summary Senior HR Analyst About the Role

The People Analyst will be a key member of the Regional People Data & Analytics team, delivering workforce insights, analytics, and strategic decision support across multiple business units globally. This role combines analytics, data management, reporting, program management, and emerging AI capabilities to enable data-driven talent decisions across Mastercard.

The ideal candidate is a detail-oriented problem solver with strong SQL and data modeling expertise, a passion for data quality, and an interest in leveraging Generative AI to improve workforce analytics and business outcomes. This individual will help transform complex people data into actionable insights while driving consistency, scalability, and innovation across reporting and analytics solutions.

Key Responsibilities
Workforce Analytics & Reporting
Serve as the primary point of contact for operational reporting, workforce metrics, and analytics requests from global stakeholders.
Partner with business leaders to understand underlying business challenges and translate them into actionable analytical solutions.
Collaborate with the Financial Planning & Analysis (FP&A) CoE to support monthly headcount reporting, forecasting, and workforce analysis.
Develop and maintain dashboards, reports, and visualizations that provide meaningful workforce insights.
Data Management & Quality
Ensure the accuracy, consistency, and integrity of workforce data across systems and reporting solutions.
Partner with HR Systems, Data Management, and Engineering teams to identify and resolve data quality issues.
Establish controls and validation processes to improve trust and reliability of workforce metrics.
Drive data governance standards and ensure compliance with privacy and security requirements for people data.
Data Modeling & Analytics Engineering
Design and maintain scalable analytical data models to support reporting, self-service analytics, AI use cases, and workforce planning.
Apply dimensional modeling principles and create efficient data structures for workforce analytics.
Leverage SQL to query, analyze, validate, and optimize large and complex datasets.
Collaborate with Data Engineers and Analysts to improve analytical data foundations and reporting capabilities.
AI & Innovation
Explore and leverage Generative AI solutions to improve reporting efficiency, automate insights generation, and enhance workforce analytics.
Identify opportunities to incorporate AI-driven capabilities into reporting, analytics, and decision support processes.
Partner with analytics teams to evaluate emerging technologies and improve the employee analytics experience.

All About You
Essential Qualifications
Experience working with organizational, workforce, HR, or people-related data.
Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with the ability to identify root causes behind business questions.
Advanced SQL skills with experience querying, analyzing, troubleshooting, and optimizing large datasets.
Strong understanding of data modeling concepts, including dimensional modeling, relationships, keys, hierarchies, and analytical data structures.
Proven ability to improve data quality, data integrity, and reporting accuracy across multiple systems and data sources.
Advanced Excel experience including Pivot Tables, XLOOKUP/VLOOKUP, formulas, conditional formatting, charts, and data analysis.
Ability to communicate complex analytical findings to non-technical audiences.
Experience building scalable reporting solutions, dashboards, and self-service analytics capabilities.
Strong collaboration skills and ability to work effectively across global teams and multiple time zones.
Ability to work within data governance, privacy, and compliance frameworks.
Flexible, proactive, and able to adapt to changing business priorities.
Excellent verbal and written communication skills.

Preferred Qualifications
Experience with HRIS platforms, preferably Workday.
Experience managing and analyzing structured and unstructured data using SQL, Python, R, or similar technologies.
Experience with BI and visualization tools such as Tableau, Power BI, Domo, or similar platforms.
Familiarity with ETL and data integration tools such as Alteryx, Informatica, or similar technologies.
Exposure to Generative AI technologies and AI-powered analytics solutions.
Experience designing analytical datasets, semantic layers, feature stores, or enterprise reporting models.
Understanding of data governance, metadata management, and enterprise data quality frameworks.
Experience influencing stakeholders and driving adoption across large, matrixed organizations.
Knowledge of workforce planning, talent analytics, organizational effectiveness, or employee experience analytics. Corporate Security Responsibility 
 Abide by Mastercard s security policies and practices; Ensure the confidentiality and integrity of the information being accessed; Report any suspected information security violation or breach, and Complete all periodic mandatory security trainings in accordance with Mastercard s guidelines.

description:
JOB TITLE: Performance Marketing Expert - Google Ads LOCATION: Pune-Hybrid (In-office every Wednesday) WORKING HOURS: 12:00 PM 9:00 PM IST EXPERIENCE: 8+ Years 
 ABOUT THE ROLE: We are seeking a highly experienced Performance Marketing Expert Google Ads to own and drive paid acquisition and B2B lead generation initiatives end-to-end. This is a hands-on, independent role for a performance marketing professional who can take ownership of a significant advertising budget, target, and account with minimal supervision. The ideal candidate will have deep expertise in Google Ads, Search, Shopping, Display, Performance Max, YouTube, GA4, and Google Tag Manager (GTM), along with strong capabilities in conversion tracking, attribution, and campaign optimization. The primary mandate is to generate a qualified pipeline from CTOs, CIOs, CDOs, VP Engineering, and other senior technology decision-makers at mid-market consumer companies, primarily in the US market. The role will be measured on MQLs, SQLs, pipeline, and revenue impact, rather than clicks, impressions, or traffic alone. We are looking for a self-driven performance marketer who treats paid media like a business, continuously identifies opportunities for optimization, and can independently diagnose and solve campaign, tracking, and performance challenges. 
 KEY RESPONSIBILITIES: 
 B2B Lead Generation & Paid Media Strategy Own the end-to-end paid search strategy for generating qualified B2B pipeline.
• Develop campaigns targeting CTOs, CIOs, CDOs, VP Engineering, and other technical/executive decision-makers.
• Build audience, keyword, targeting, and messaging strategies aligned with technical executive personas.
• Structure paid campaigns around the complete funnel: Awareness MQL SQL Opportunity Revenue.
• Develop targeting strategies using relevant firmographic attributes, job titles, company size, industry, intent signals, and geographic targeting.
• Continuously optimize targeting to improve lead quality and pipeline contribution, not simply lead volume.
• Work closely with Sales and RevOps teams to align on lead scoring, MQL/SQL definitions, lead quality, and sales hand-off criteria.

 Google Ads Management Plan, build, manage, and optimize Google Ads campaigns across Search, Shopping, Display, Performance Max, and YouTube.

• Develop and manage comprehensive keyword strategies.
• Manage match types, negative keyword lists, search terms, Quality Score, ad relevance, and landing page relevance.

• Monitor campaign and account health regularly.
• Analyze and troubleshoot changes in spend, CPC, CTR, conversion rate, CPA, Quality Score, and impression share.
• Manage budget pacing and reallocation across campaigns based on performance.
• Conduct structured A/B testing across ad copy, targeting, landing pages, bidding strategies, and campaign structures.
• Stay updated on Google Ads policy changes, platform updates, new features, and betas and proactively implement relevant opportunities. 
 GA4 & Conversion Tracking Own and maintain Google Analytics 4 (GA4) configuration for paid media measurement.
• Configure and manage events, conversion events, custom dimensions, custom metrics, audiences, funnels, and exploration reports.
• Implement and QA conversion tracking for form submissions, calls, website conversions, e-commerce actions where applicable, and offline conversions.
• Ensure accurate integration between Google Ads, GA4, GTM, and CRM systems.
• Analyze user journeys and conversion paths to identify performance opportunities.
• Troubleshoot discrepancies between Google Ads, GA4, GTM, and CRM data.
• Support attribution and measurement initiatives for multi-touch B2B sales journeys.
• Ensure paid media performance is measured against qualified business outcomes. 
 Google Tag Manager (GTM) & Tracking Infrastructure Independently configure and manage Google Tag Manager containers.
• Create and manage tags, triggers, variables, custom events, and conversion tracking.
• Define and maintain website data layer requirements.
• Work with developers to implement and validate tracking requirements.
• Use custom JavaScript/data layer variables where required.
• QA tracking implementations before and after website releases.
• Identify and resolve tracking gaps, broken tags, duplicate events, and attribution discrepancies.
• Maintain clean and reliable tracking infrastructure across the marketing funnel.
• Ensure data consistency between GTM GA4 Google Ads CRM. 
 Analytics, Attribution & Reporting Build and maintain performance dashboards using Looker Studio or similar reporting platforms.
• Connect and analyze Google Ads and GA4 data to provide a complete view of campaign performance.
• Track key metrics including MQLs, SQLs, MQL-to-SQL conversion, CPL, CPA, ROAS, pipeline contribution, and revenue.
• Implement appropriate UTM structures and campaign tracking standards.
• Analyze conversion paths and attribution across long, multi-touch B2B sales cycles.
• Identify discrepancies and data-quality issues across advertising, analytics, and CRM platforms.
• Translate complex campaign data into clear, actionable recommendations for business stakeholders.
• Provide regular performance reporting focused on business impact rather than vanity metrics. 
 Strategy, Optimization & Budget Management Translate business objectives into measurable paid media strategies.
• Develop campaign forecasts, budgets, and performance targets in collaboration with leadership.
• Monitor spend and optimize budget allocation based on lead quality and revenue potential.
• Identify underperforming campaigns, audiences, keywords, and creatives and take corrective action.
• Continuously test new keywords, audiences, ad messaging, landing pages, bidding strategies, campaign structures, and conversion approaches.
• Evaluate incrementality and attribution to understand the true contribution of paid search.
• Identify opportunities to scale campaigns while maintaining lead quality and commercial efficiency.
• Stay ahead of changes in paid search, measurement, privacy, and advertising technology. 
 Cross-Functional Collaboration Collaborate with Sales, RevOps, Content, Design, Web, ABM, and Marketing teams.
• Work with Sales to understand lead quality and improve campaign targeting.
• Partner with Content and Design teams on ad creative and landing page optimization.
• Work with Web/Engineering teams on tracking, data layer, and conversion implementation.
• Collaborate with RevOps to establish reliable lead attribution and closed-loop reporting.

 QUALIFICATIONS & EXPERIENCE: .

• Strong B2B demand-generation mindset.
• Advanced campaign architecture and optimization capabilities.
• Strong GA4 & GTM expertise.
• Strong conversion tracking and attribution knowledge.

 KEY PERFORMANCE INDICATORS (KPIs): MQLs: Qualified leads generated through Google Ads campaigns.

title: Research Associate - Safe Drinking Water - J-PAL South Asia
company: Abdul Latif Jameel Poverty Action Lab
description:
Job Summary J-PAL South Asia is inviting expressions of interest for upcoming Research Associate (RA) positions across a variety of sectors and geographies. RAs at J-PAL play a central role in managing the implementation of randomized evaluations, working closely with researchers from leading Universities around the world, ensuring that each evaluation is designed and implemented with precision and rigor. Project Description The research team plans to conduct a study in Andhra Pradesh and Odisha to evaluate community perceptions of chlorinated drinking water through taste test experiments to optimize water treatment practices. This study follows efforts by the Ministry of Jal Shakti's Jal Jeevan Mission to provide drinking water tap connections to every rural household by 2028. As part of these efforts, the Jal Jeevan Mission has recently approved the use of a drinking water treatment method called in-line chlorination to provide safe water to rural communities. Members of this research team recently conducted an RCT of in-line chlorination in drinking water schemes in Odisha, finding that it could effectively reduce E. coli contamination at tap connections by 70%. However, further research is needed to understand how in-line chlorination can be optimized for chlorinated water taste preferences across India. This research directly supports the Ministry of Jal Shakti's Jal Jeevan Mission, which aims to provide safe drinking water tap connections to all rural households in India by 2028. The planned study will evaluate taste detection and acceptability thresholds for chlorinated water among villages in Rayagada, Odisha, and Vijayawada, Andhra Pradesh. To evaluate this, the team will conduct a series of blinded taste tests with unchlorinated and chlorinated water samples of varying concentrations to determine levels at which participants can correctly identify chlorinated water samples and their rating of the taste/preferences. This research will directly inform future water chlorination projects by setting chlorine concentrations at levels that are preferred by communities while providing effective disinfection. The candidate will work closely with a multidisciplinary research team from Community Welfare Society Hospital Rourkela (Dr. Praveen Sahu), University of Michigan School of Public Health (Dr. Elisa Maffioli), and University of California Berkeley Department of Civil and Environmental Engineering (Dr. Amy Pickering). The candidate will contribute to study design and methods and lead data collection in each study site alongside the research team. Key Responsibilities The responsibilities of a Research Associate typically include, but are not limited to: Supporting researchers in developing and refining study protocols through in-field scoping activities. You will provide contextual and operational insights to help researchers shape experimental protocols that are methodologically rigorous and feasible within the study setting. Strengthening measurement validity and reliability by assisting in the development and piloting of survey instruments. You will be responsible for organizing field tests, analyzing pilot data, and integrating structured feedback loops to improve the precision and accuracy of indicators. Enable accurate and efficient data capture through the programming of digital surveys and development of end-to-end data workflows. This includes incorporating survey logic, real-time checks, and secure data transmission to ensure clean, analysis-ready datasets. Ensuring collection of high-quality primary data-recruiting, training, and managing field teams to collect data that meets rigorous research standards. Safeguarding data integrity in consultation with the research team by setting up and maintaining systems for real-time quality monitoring. You will identify issues in incoming data, identify solutions in collaboration with the researchers, and implement corrective measures. Preparing analysis-ready datasets by writing reproducible code (in Stata, R, or Python), generating summary statistics, and contributing to the analytical preparation for publications, working closely with researchers. Facilitating alignment between research teams and implementation partners to ensure that project implementation aligns with study protocols. You will coordinate timelines, share updates across teams, and help troubleshoot day-to-day challenges while maintaining strong working relationships with external stakeholders. Ensuring transparency and reproducibility by developing and maintaining detailed documentation, including codebooks, field protocols, and project logs that align with academic standards and support eventual replication and publication. Maintaining strict adherence to J-PAL's research protocols throughout all stages of the research lifecycle. What We're Looking For Strong problem-solving skills and a proactive approach to addressing operational and analytical challenges Ability to manage day-to-day work with minimal supervision Excellent time management and attention to detail Ability to navigate fast-evolving settings that require flexibility and initiative Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to adapt messaging for diverse audiences Required Knowledge and Skills A Bachelor's/Master's degree in economics, sociology, social sciences, public policy, public health or related fields. Other technical degrees with focus on engineering, water supply and treatment, or civil engineering will also be considered. Sound understanding of impact evaluation methods, especially randomized controlled trials (RCTs) Proficiency in data analysis and statistical tools such as R (preferred) or Stata. Experience with digital data collection platforms such as SurveyCTO (preferred) or Qualtrics. Fluency in English and Hindi; proficiency in one or more regional languages (Odia or Telugu) is a strong asset Willingness to travel extensively and stay in field locations. This is a multi-site study requiring extensive travel to Rayagada, Odisha, and Vijayawada, Andhra Pradesh. Experience working with external stakeholders such as government departments or NGOs is a plus . Note on Work Authorizations Candidates must have work authorization to work in India. Length of Commitment Full-time, 9-month position with possible extension

title: Sr. Consultant
description:
Trinity is seeking a Senior Consultant to join our growing Analytics organization with a focus on delivering data and AI-enabled analytics solutions. This role blends strong analytics execution, business understanding and practical application of AI (including GenAI and LLM-based approaches) across commercial use cases. Trinity is a 1400-person, global organization that partners with ~350 life sciences companies annually. At the highest level, we provide Strategy, Insights, and Analytics support. Within Analytics, we have well-established SME verticals (e.g., forecasting, sales analytics, commercial data solutions, data science, AI/ML solutions). Trinity is investing in expanding our Analytics Strategy team , a seller-doer group that owns client relationships and overall account delivery. Senior Consultants are responsible for delivery excellence, while helping scale Trinity s AI-enabled analytics capabilities. This is a unique opportunity to join an established firm and work in an entrepreneurial environment, building and scaling a fast-growing team within a core strategic priority area for Trinity. Position Summary Trinity is seeking a talented, committed, and entrepreneurial individual to join our Enterprise Analytics Delivery (EAD) team as a Sr. Consultant. The EAD team acts as the pan - analytics backbone, orchestrating end-to-end execution, client partnership, and commercial growth for complex analytics programs . The Consultant is responsible for: Developing analysis design for client problems, with responsibility for quality, timeliness, and business impact Ensuring technical rigor across a range of analytics approaches (from descriptive and diagnostic analysis to advanced analytics and AI/ML) The ideal candidate for this position will contribute to the firm s success through a strong work ethic, particularly in team settings, and can communicate with statisticians, data analysts, and business stakeholders alike. The Sr. Consultant should be able to independently run complex analyses, while guiding junior team members and bringing in relevant life sciences context. Position Responsibilities: This role is an important position within our team, engaging directly with global clients, leading internal teams, building capabilities and standard operating procedures (SOPs), and collaborating with seamlessly with integrated Trinity teams across US, EU, and APAC. Delivery Leadership Lead specific analytical workstreams within a project, from problem framing and workplan development through analysis, synthesis, quality review, and final recommendations. Understand and work with secondary RWE datasets such as claims, EMR, sales Data, Patient Level Datasets, and other real-world data sources to support commercial and analytical insights generation (e.g., IQVIA, Komodo, Symphony, Flatiron, Definitive) Partner with senior project leaders within Trinity to understand and refine the contextual why for business questions and structure the insights such that inform strategy and decision-making. Be responsible for analysis execution using a selection of tools like Excel (along with Copilot), SQL, R, Python, or other analytical tools Identify gaps in analysis plan and data limitations as project progresses, and communicate effectively with project leaders to ensure resolution Apply advanced data science methodologies and AI/ML models for client problems, support the design and deployment Trinity s technology solutions in client environments. Mentoring and Coaching Mentor and review the work of Associates, Associate Consultants and Consultants, providing feedback to strengthen problem solving, analytics execution, and client readiness. Serve as direct people manager and own reporting lines; Coach team members to build stronger analytical, project management, and communication skills through day-to-day guidance and apprenticeship. Teach junior team members how to use AI tools and automation responsibly in analytics delivery and operational workflows. Support capability building across the EAD team by identifying development opportunities and helping junior staff grow. Business Development Support Gain methodological/ analytics approach expertise by aiding in proposal development as needed. Contribute to pitch materials and case examples that showcase EAD capabilities across forecasting, brand analytics, RWE, access analytics, sales analytics, advanced modeling, AI/ML, and AI-enabled delivery. Required Qualifications Education: Bachelors degree in a quantitative, technical, scientific, business, or related field; advanced degree preferred. Work Experience: 5+ years of direct work experience in a related field (life sciences consulting, biopharma analytics, and/or general consulting). Other Important Skills: Experience in life sciences, including healthcare, pharmaceutical, biotech, or medtech business questions and data. Strong proficiency in analytical tools such as Excel, SQL, R, or Python, with the ability to execute and review complex analyses. Experience across commercial, market, customer, and evidence-generation use cases, including forecasting, segmentation, sales or performance analytics, access analytics, and advanced modeling. Familiarity with statistical modeling, scenario analysis, machine learning, deployment-oriented workflows, and AI-enabled productivity or automation tools. Experience managing and mentoring junior team members in a professional services, consulting, or analytics environment. Knowledge of implementing custom AI Agents is a plus.

description:

Proactively flag oversold, unavailable, or discontinued items and recommend suitable alternatives to Sales and E-commerce. Source alternative units including modification or replacement options when an ordered product is out of stock or non-working. Act as the primary point of technical escalation for Sales, Procurement, and E-commerce; handle direct client technical queries via email, phone, and WhatsApp. 
 Protect Every Customer Touchpoint Audit product listings across all portals for part number, specification, image, condition, quantity, price, and description accuracy. Cross-check Email and WhatsApp conversations of Purchase and Sales Department for accuracy, professionalism, and response-time (TAT) compliance. Verify quotations, Proforma Invoices, and order confirmations product links, pricing, quantity, warranty terms, shipping, and currency before anything reaches the customer. Identify recurring communication or documentation errors and drive corrective action to stop repeated mistakes. 
 Keep Shipments and Cash Moving Run pre-dispatch checks on condition, quantity, and packaging; review sold orders daily with Sales and Marketing. Track pending shipments, coordinate DHL/FedEx returns, and chase stuck or delayed shipments through to resolution. Support customs-related matters and escalate critical shipment or clearance issues promptly. Own the return, refund, and credit-term process end-to-end, coordinating with Accounts and Logistics. 
 Build the Systems Behind the Scenes Maintain and analyze Sales and performance data (AMT, A2M, AM), preparing figures and reports for decision-making. Maintain vendor registration forms and official documentation requiring authorized signatures and stamps. Maintain accurate records of dispatched, pending, returned, stuck, and customs-hold shipments; verify client data against approved lists. 
 Lead Without Waiting for a Title Coordinate across Sales, Accounts, Procurement, Logistics, and E-commerce to resolve operational issues and keep workflow smooth. Step into routine responsibilities of the Sales Head, Purchase Head, or other senior leads when they're unavailable. Lead product/technical training and Training Needs Analysis (TNA) sessions to close skill gaps across the team. Monitor daily reporting channels and deliver consolidated performance reporting to management. Who We're Looking For Solid experience in a technical, quality, or operations role — ideally where you own outcomes across more than one function, not just your own lane. Industrial products, e-commerce, or parts distribution background is a strong plus. A low tolerance for "close enough" — inconsistent listings, vague quotes, and stuck shipments bother you until they're fixed. Comfortable holding other teams accountable without built-in authority over them — through data, credibility, and follow-through, not hierarchy. Strong analytical and documentation instincts, with the ability to switch between hands-on troubleshooting and management-level reporting in the same day. Engineering or technical degree preferred — but a proven track record matters more than the paper. 
 Must-Have Capabilities Technical product identification and cross-referencing Industrial/electrical/electronic product understanding Quality auditing Quotation/PI/order verification Excel/MIS/data analysis Logistics escalation Strong documentation Root-cause analysis Cross-functional coordination Team accountability Good written and verbal communication High attention to detail

title: Senior Software Engineer (Data and AI)
description:
Senior Software Engineer, AI & Data 
 
 Location : Bangalore, India 
Employment type: Direct Agreement with WALT US (no local contract) 
 Experience : 4-7 years 
 Company : thewalt.ai 
 #AIEngineer #DataEngineering #SQL #Python #Snowflake #dbt #AgenticAI #DistributedSystems #SemanticLayer 
 
 About WALT 
WALT (thewalt.ai) is building the world's first Autonomous Data Engineer: a platform of five specialised, collaborating AI agents (Ingestor, Transformer, Reasoner, Operator, and Governor) that manage an entire data platform end-to-end, covering ingestion, transformation, analytics, monitoring, and governance. 
 What makes WALT different is how it answers business questions. Instead of relying on an LLM to generate SQL on the fly, our Reasoner agent uses deterministic analytical inference over a Data Context Graph (ReasonBase), a context layer that maps business vocabulary to the underlying data. The result is the same trusted answer, every time. That reliability is why regulated, data-intensive customers in financial services, retail, and advertising trust us with their analytics: they get auditability, compliance, and consistency, not stochastic guesses. 
 We're an early-stage, fast-moving team obsessed with correctness, security, and delivering analytics people can actually rely on. 
 
 The Role 
We're looking for an AI-native Senior Software Engineer to help build the data and analytical products at the core of WALT, the systems that turn raw, messy enterprise data into trusted, deterministic answers at scale. 
 This is a hands-on builder-and-coder role, not a purely advisory or architect one. You'll design, implement, and evaluate core components of how our agents reason over data, build the platform that makes that reasoning fast, correct, and governable, and go deep to prove out the hard parts in code. You'll be a strong individual contributor and a key technical voice as WALT scales, a force multiplier for the engineering team. 
 If you've spent your career building analytical and data products ( semantic layers, query/inference engines, BI and analytics platforms, or large-scale data pipelines ) and you want to build a category-defining product hands-on, this is for you. 
 What You'll Do Design, implement, and evaluate core components of WALT's analytical and data products: the context layer (ReasonBase), the deterministic inference engine, and the data platform the agents operate on. Build systems that produce correct, reproducible, and auditable analytical results across large, heterogeneous enterprise datasets. Contribute to the foundational technical decisions: data modelling and the semantic/knowledge graph, query and inference execution, storage and compute, orchestration across the agent framework, and the boundaries between neural and symbolic components. Partner with FDEs and founding engineers to translate ambiguous customer problems across industries into robust, scalable implementations. Uphold and raise engineering standards for performance, reliability, security, and compliance (auditability, lineage, governance). Own critical services end-to-end, writing reference implementations and reviewing important code. Mentor engineers and contribute to design and code reviews as the team grows. 
 Core experience 4+ years building production software, with meaningful time spent on data-intensive and analytical products (analytics/BI platforms, semantic layers, query or inference engines, data warehouses/lakes, or large-scale data pipelines). A track record of owning and shipping complex components or services end-to-end, seen running in production, ideally at a data or product company (e.g., Fivetran, dbt, Snowflake). Solid foundation in distributed systems and data engineering: data modelling, query processing, storage/compute trade-offs, and building for correctness and scale. Strong grasp of the analytics stack: SQL and modern data warehouses (e.g., Snowflake, BigQuery, Databricks), transformation frameworks (e.g., dbt), and orchestration. Fluency in one or more backend languages used for data systems (e.g., Python, Java/Scala, Go, or Rust). Ability to reason rigorously about data correctness, reproducibility, and auditability. You care that the answer is right and explainable, not just fast. Hands-on experience (or strong, demonstrated interest) building with agentic AI: designing, orchestrating, and shipping systems built on LLM/agent frameworks and multiple collaborating agents. 
 How you work Hands-on: you design by building and earn technical trust through code and prototypes. Comfortable with ambiguity and an early-stage pace. You empathise with customers and go deep to solve their real problems, turning a fuzzy need into shipped software rather than a slide. A clear communicator who collaborates well and helps level up the engineers around you. 
 Nice to have Experience with semantic layers, knowledge graphs, ontologies, or symbolic/rule-based reasoning . Experience with ML/LLM systems (neuro-symbolic approaches); ability to train or fine-tune models. Background delivering software into regulated or data-sensitive industries (financial services, retail/adtech, healthcare) with real compliance, governance, and security requirements. 
 Why WALT Help build a genuinely new category , the autonomous data engineer, from an early and influential seat. Work on hard, meaningful problems where correctness and trust are the product, not an afterthought. Direct impact with enterprise customers in high-stakes, regulated domains. A team that values reliability, security, and doing the hard engineering right. 
 Learn more at https://www.thewalt.ai

They will document and implement a standardized, fit-to-standard migration approach, drive data profiling and validation, and align migration with testing and ALM processes (e.g., SAP Cloud ALM ). Strong stakeholder management, strategy documentation, and execution capability are critical to ensure successful go-live and scalable delivery models. 
 Must Have: Proven experience leading the data migration workstream on at least three endtoend SAP implementations. Strong handson expertise with SAP data migration tools (e.g. S/4 Migration Cockpit, CrystalBridge) and approaches (e.g. fittostandard data scoping, iterative mock loads, reconciliation, and businessled data readiness). 6+ years’ experience delivering data migration for enterprise SAP programmes, with recent handson experience on SAP S/4HANA Public Cloud. Demonstrated ability to define and enforce data migration governance including standards, templates, reconciliation rules, and cutover controls. Deep understanding of SAP master data and transactional data principles. Excellent problem-solving and communication skills. Ability to work autonomously whilst leading and supporting others. Nice to Have Certification in any ETL tools or approaches (e.g. Informatica, BODS, ADM, Syniti). Experience building or scaling a repeatable delivery model or factory for SAP enterprise estates. Experience integrating data migration activities with test management and ALM tooling (e.g. SAP Cloud ALM). Experience working in regulated industries (insurance, financial services, aerospace, pharma, etc.). Understanding of ABAP, ABAP artifacts and ABAP development skills. Day-To-Day: SAP Data workstream leadership and planning. Perform functional consulting activities in advisory & implementation projects with a focus on Data Migration and Data Quality. Assess technical landscape, source systems, applications & technical artifacts, and recommend Strategy for Data Migration & Data Quality Improvement. Contribute to the development of the migration rules, documenting these rules, developing user test cases for migration test runs, testing the rules during the migration runs. Support the business in all questions related to migration; of analyzing and preparing the data, in extracting the data, in transforming the data, in validation of the migration, in verifying data in the target system. Analyse legacy systems and current data structures to assess migration requirements and identify potential challenges. Define data quality standards, validation rules, and governance frameworks to ensure data integrity post-migration. Design and implement data transformation rules, ensuring data integrity and execute data migration strategies, including ETL processes, validation, and reconciliation. Analyse existing business processes, identify areas for improvement, and define data-related process workflows. Develop functional specifications and ensure they align with technical solutions. Provide clear requirements to technical teams. Provide end-user training and create detailed documentation for processes, workflows, and best practices. Analyse complex data sets and design effective transformation rules. Roles & Responsibilities Lead the endtoend data migration workstream for SAP S/4HANA Public Cloud and other implementations, from data readiness through mock loads, cutover, and golive. Define and execute a standardised, SAPaligned Public Cloud data migration approach, ensuring fittostandard, clean core, and appropriate data scope decisions. Establish and enforce data migration governance, including standards, templates, reconciliation rules, quality criteria, and cutover controls. Design and build reusable data migration assets and accelerators to support a scalable and repeatable Public Cloud delivery model. Drive data profiling, cleansing, validation, and reconciliation activities in collaboration with business and functional teams. Plan and manage migration cycles, mock runs, and dress rehearsals, ensuring readiness for testing and release milestones. Engage, influence and support client stakeholders to ensure business ownership of data quality and migration decisions. Stay current with the latest SAP Data tools and best practices and delivery thought-leadership pieces, like blogs, whitepaper etc.

title: Senior Penetration Testing Analyst
description:
Job Summary 
 Sophos is seeking an experienced and motivated Senior Penetration Testing Analyst 2 to join our Red Team. The Sophos Red Team is engaged by organizations worldwide to identify and exploit vulnerabilities within client environments, applying information security threat intelligence to uncover the same weaknesses real-world adversaries would target. As a Senior Penetration Testing Analyst, you will focus on either application security (web application penetration testing, mobile, API testing) or network security (vulnerability assessments, external penetration tests, internal penetration tests, etc.), using both off-the-shelf and internally developed tools to execute manual testing for advanced attacks. Candidates are not expected to be experienced in both focus areas, although that would be a plus. In this role, you will produce professional security assessment reports detailing vulnerability and exploit information for clients, and will lead client-facing calls throughout each engagement, from project kick-off through notification of high and critical findings to a close-out review of test findings, evidence, process steps to reproduce, and remediation recommendations. The ideal candidate for this role will bring strong technical communication skills, sound analytical and problem-solving abilities, and a proactive approach to researching new threats, vulnerabilities, and exploits. You will excel as both a self-directed individual contributor and as a member of a larger team, performing other essential duties as assigned. 
 
 What you will do 
 This is a remote position with potential travel up to 10% Conduct application security assessments (web, mobile, API, etc.) using off-the-shelf or internally developed exploitation tools to execute manual testing for advanced attacks OR network penetration testing assessments (external pen test, internal pen test, etc.) Produce and deliver vulnerability and exploit information to clients in the form of a professional security assessment report Conduct client conference calls, including but not limited to project kick-off calls, notification of high/critical findings during the testing process, and close-out calls to review test findings, evidence, process steps to reproduce, and remediation recommendations Perform proactive research to identify and understand new threats, vulnerabilities, and exploits Conduct exploitation testing using off-the-shelf or self-developed exploitation tools and document findings for client remediation Excel as both a self-directed individual contributor and as a member of a larger team Perform other essential duties as assigned 
 
 What you will bring 
 Typically requires 6+ years of related experience in a professional role with a Bachelor s degree; or 5+ years with a Master s degree; or 3+ years with a PhD; or equivalent experience. Minimum of 4 years of experience with penetration testing Minimum of 4 years of experience with at least one of the following: Nmap, Metasploit, Kali Linux, Burp Suite Offensive certifications such as CEH, WAPT, GPEN, GWAPT, GAWN, OSCP, etc. Desirable: Knowledge of NetSparker and AppScan; operating systems administration and internals (Microsoft Windows / Linux) Experience with various application attack vectors, security test processes, and strong knowledge of common vulnerabilities (i.e. OWASP Top 10) Understanding of TCP/IP networking at a technical level Bachelor of Science degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, Electrical Engineering, or a related technical field; or equivalent professional experience Working knowledge of SQL and high-level languages Good technical communication skills, both written and verbal; good analytical and problem-solving skills

title: Senior Consultant Data Migration
description:
The Senior Consultant Data Migration will lead the end-to-end data migration workstream for SAP S/4HANA Public Cloud implementations. The role requires strong hands-on expertise with SAP migration tools such as SAP S/4HANA Migration Cockpit and Crystal Bridge , along with deep knowledge of SAP master and transactional data. The consultant will define migration strategy, governance, reconciliation rules, mock load cycles, and cutover controls, ensuring data quality and business ownership. They will document and implement a standardized, fit-to-standard migration approach, drive data profiling and validation, and align migration with testing and ALM processes (e.g., SAP Cloud ALM ). Strong stakeholder management, strategy documentation, and execution capability are critical to ensure successful go-live and scalable delivery models. 
 Must Have: Proven experience leading the data migration workstream on at least three endtoend SAP implementations. Strong handson expertise with SAP data migration tools (e.g. S/4 Migration Cockpit, CrystalBridge) and approaches (e.g. fittostandard data scoping, iterative mock loads, reconciliation, and businessled data readiness). 6+ years’ experience delivering data migration for enterprise SAP programmes, with recent handson experience on SAP S/4HANA Public Cloud. Demonstrated ability to define and enforce data migration governance including standards, templates, reconciliation rules, and cutover controls. Deep understanding of SAP master data and transactional data principles. Excellent problem-solving and communication skills. Ability to work autonomously whilst leading and supporting others. Nice to Have Certification in any ETL tools or approaches (e.g. Informatica, BODS, ADM, Syniti). Experience building or scaling a repeatable delivery model or factory for SAP enterprise estates. Experience integrating data migration activities with test management and ALM tooling (e.g. SAP Cloud ALM). Experience working in regulated industries (insurance, financial services, aerospace, pharma, etc.). Understanding of ABAP, ABAP artifacts and ABAP development skills. Day-To-Day: SAP Data workstream leadership and planning. Perform functional consulting activities in advisory & implementation projects with a focus on Data Migration and Data Quality. Assess technical landscape, source systems, applications & technical artifacts, and recommend Strategy for Data Migration & Data Quality Improvement. Contribute to the development of the migration rules, documenting these rules, developing user test cases for migration test runs, testing the rules during the migration runs. Support the business in all questions related to migration; of analyzing and preparing the data, in extracting the data, in transforming the data, in validation of the migration, in verifying data in the target system. Analyse legacy systems and current data structures to assess migration requirements and identify potential challenges. Define data quality standards, validation rules, and governance frameworks to ensure data integrity post-migration. Design and implement data transformation rules, ensuring data integrity and execute data migration strategies, including ETL processes, validation, and reconciliation. Analyse existing business processes, identify areas for improvement, and define data-related process workflows. Develop functional specifications and ensure they align with technical solutions. Provide clear requirements to technical teams. Provide end-user training and create detailed documentation for processes, workflows, and best practices. Analyse complex data sets and design effective transformation rules. Roles & Responsibilities Lead the endtoend data migration workstream for SAP S/4HANA Public Cloud and other implementations, from data readiness through mock loads, cutover, and golive. Define and execute a standardised, SAPaligned Public Cloud data migration approach, ensuring fittostandard, clean core, and appropriate data scope decisions. Establish and enforce data migration governance, including standards, templates, reconciliation rules, quality criteria, and cutover controls. Design and build reusable data migration assets and accelerators to support a scalable and repeatable Public Cloud delivery model. Drive data profiling, cleansing, validation, and reconciliation activities in collaboration with business and functional teams. Plan and manage migration cycles, mock runs, and dress rehearsals, ensuring readiness for testing and release milestones. Engage, influence and support client stakeholders to ensure business ownership of data quality and migration decisions. Stay current with the latest SAP Data tools and best practices and delivery thought-leadership pieces, like blogs, whitepaper etc.

title: Contract Integration Tester
description:
The role of the Integration Tester ensures that relevant Inspired Retail Products are tested adhering to both external compliance and in house testing standards. The Integration Tester will conduct both scripted and non-scripted tests, using Test Rail for identification of test cases and capturing outputs in Jira. Integration Testers will be required to adhere to timely completion of required test cycles, in line with scheduled development and delivery plans. Reporting to the Integration Test Lead, Integration testers will follow Inspireds Integration test guidelines, in accordance with Quality Assurance and Quality Control Specialists. The role is of critical importance to ensuring the quality of Inspireds products, be that platform components or game content. Attention to detail, and an excellent knowledge and comprehension of the English language, both verbally and in written form, is essential. 
 Specific Responsibilities and Experience 
 Responsibilities Conduct pre-determined and non-scripted test steps, on internally developed platforms, product and content, in line with agreed test schedule. Ensuring precise & detailed reporting of test execution and outcome within the bug tracking tool, Jira. Ensure issues identified during execution of test steps are documented with sufficient detail to allow them to be re-produced for investigation. Ensure all issues are correctly identified on scale of criticality, with associated evidence provided, to allow for efficient triage by project teams. Pro-actively escalate areas of concern to the Integration Test Lead, Quality Assurance and Quality Control Specialists, as appropriate. Deployment of testing content to test machines, utilising approved software and processes. Adhere to Company policies with regards to security and health and safety, reporting any breaches immediately to your Line Manager. Maintain confidentiality of all information received and acted upon. Undertake any other reasonable duties as requested by Line Manager and other Senior Company Management. To report any unresolved, escalating issues relating to a Customer, Supplier or team member, to your line manager within a timely fashion. 
 Required Skills and Experience At least 1 years experience of working in an Integration Test environment, team or function, handling multiple test environments, and/or projects simultaneously. At least 1 years’ experience of using Bug Tracking Software, such as JIRA. At least 1 years’ experience of using Test Management System such as Test Rail. At least 1 years Policy / Standards / Protocol based testing experience. At least 1 years’ experience in Hardware / Device Set Up for test activity in a Test Lab environment. General IT knowledge, confidence and literacy (ability to use MS Office, able to install software, copy files, etc.). Excellent written and oral communication and comprehension skills. Ability to think outside the box. Keen eye for detail. Ability to manage own deadlines effectively. Ability to multi-task effectively under pressure whilst maintaining a quality deliverable. Ability to stay focused when completing repetitive tasks. Self-motivated, with a confident and flexible approach to any given working environment. Able to accept and adapt to change in policies and procedures. Ability to understand and interpret functional specifications and technical documentation. Methodical, systematic and disciplined approach to task list. 
 Beneficial Experience An understanding of the Gaming Industry, regulations, and the impact on game product testing and release. Knowledge of client/server architecture. Experience of automated testing. Understanding of hardware testing issues. ISTQB / ISEB Foundation Certificate in Software Testing. Experience of using JIRA and Test Rail.

title: Senior Consultant Data Migration
description:
The Senior Consultant Data Migration will lead the end-to-end data migration workstream for SAP S/4HANA Public Cloud implementations. The role requires strong hands-on expertise with SAP migration tools such as SAP S/4HANA Migration Cockpit and Crystal Bridge , along with deep knowledge of SAP master and transactional data. The consultant will define migration strategy, governance, reconciliation rules, mock load cycles, and cutover controls, ensuring data quality and business ownership. They will document and implement a standardized, fit-to-standard migration approach, drive data profiling and validation, and align migration with testing and ALM processes (e.g., SAP Cloud ALM ). Strong stakeholder management, strategy documentation, and execution capability are critical to ensure successful go-live and scalable delivery models. 
 Must Have: Proven experience leading the data migration workstream on at least three endtoend SAP implementations. Strong handson expertise with SAP data migration tools (e.g. S/4 Migration Cockpit, CrystalBridge) and approaches (e.g. fittostandard data scoping, iterative mock loads, reconciliation, and businessled data readiness). 6+ years’ experience delivering data migration for enterprise SAP programmes, with recent handson experience on SAP S/4HANA Public Cloud. Demonstrated ability to define and enforce data migration governance including standards, templates, reconciliation rules, and cutover controls. Deep understanding of SAP master data and transactional data principles. Excellent problem-solving and communication skills. Ability to work autonomously whilst leading and supporting others. Nice to Have Certification in any ETL tools or approaches (e.g. Informatica, BODS, ADM, Syniti). Experience building or scaling a repeatable delivery model or factory for SAP enterprise estates. Experience integrating data migration activities with test management and ALM tooling (e.g. SAP Cloud ALM). Experience working in regulated industries (insurance, financial services, aerospace, pharma, etc.). Understanding of ABAP, ABAP artifacts and ABAP development skills. Day-To-Day: SAP Data workstream leadership and planning. Perform functional consulting activities in advisory & implementation projects with a focus on Data Migration and Data Quality. Assess technical landscape, source systems, applications & technical artifacts, and recommend Strategy for Data Migration & Data Quality Improvement. Contribute to the development of the migration rules, documenting these rules, developing user test cases for migration test runs, testing the rules during the migration runs. Support the business in all questions related to migration; of analyzing and preparing the data, in extracting the data, in transforming the data, in validation of the migration, in verifying data in the target system. Analyse legacy systems and current data structures to assess migration requirements and identify potential challenges. Define data quality standards, validation rules, and governance frameworks to ensure data integrity post-migration. Design and implement data transformation rules, ensuring data integrity and execute data migration strategies, including ETL processes, validation, and reconciliation. Analyse existing business processes, identify areas for improvement, and define data-related process workflows. Develop functional specifications and ensure they align with technical solutions. Provide clear requirements to technical teams. Provide end-user training and create detailed documentation for processes, workflows, and best practices. Analyse complex data sets and design effective transformation rules. Roles & Responsibilities Lead the endtoend data migration workstream for SAP S/4HANA Public Cloud and other implementations, from data readiness through mock loads, cutover, and golive. Define and execute a standardised, SAPaligned Public Cloud data migration approach, ensuring fittostandard, clean core, and appropriate data scope decisions. Establish and enforce data migration governance, including standards, templates, reconciliation rules, quality criteria, and cutover controls. Design and build reusable data migration assets and accelerators to support a scalable and repeatable Public Cloud delivery model. Drive data profiling, cleansing, validation, and reconciliation activities in collaboration with business and functional teams. Plan and manage migration cycles, mock runs, and dress rehearsals, ensuring readiness for testing and release milestones. Engage, influence and support client stakeholders to ensure business ownership of data quality and migration decisions. Stay current with the latest SAP Data tools and best practices and delivery thought-leadership pieces, like blogs, whitepaper etc.

Key Skills: SAP migration,ALM processes,SAP data migration,SAP Cloud ALM,SAP S/4HANA Public Cloud,ABAP development,SAP S/4HANA Migration Cockpit,S/4 Migration Cockpit

title: Linux Administrator
description:
About Position: 
 We are looking for a skilled Linux Administrator with strong expertise in Linux Administration, SQL, and Oracle Database. The ideal candidate will be responsible for server administration, database support, monitoring, troubleshooting, performance optimization, and ensuring high availability of business-critical applications and database environments. Information found in internal profiles highlights Linux administration, Oracle database operations, SQL troubleshooting, and production support responsibilities. 
 Role: Linux Administrator  Location: Hyderabad & Bengaluru Experience: 8 to 12 Years Job Type: Full Time Employment 
 What You'll Do: 
 Administer, maintain, and support Linux servers across production, development, testing, and disaster recovery environments. Monitor server performance, system health, capacity utilization, and application availability. Manage Oracle databases including installation, configuration, backup, recovery, patching, and routine administration. Write, optimize, and troubleshoot SQL and PL/SQL queries for application and database support activities. Analyze and resolve server, application, database, and infrastructure-related incidents. Perform root cause analysis for recurring issues and implement preventive and corrective measures. Manage user accounts, access controls, file systems, permissions, and security configurations within Linux environments. Support application deployments, release management, and production maintenance activities. Monitor database performance and recommend tuning improvements to enhance efficiency and reliability. Ensure backup and recovery procedures are implemented, tested, and maintained for business continuity. Collaborate with application developers, database administrators, and infrastructure teams to resolve complex technical issues. Maintain operational documentation, runbooks, support procedures, and knowledge repositories. Proactively identify risks, vulnerabilities, and performance bottlenecks and recommend remediation plans. Ensure adherence to organizational standards, security policies, and operational processes. Participate in on-call support and critical incident management activities when required. 
 Expertise You'll Bring: 
 8 to 12 years of experience in Linux Administration, Oracle Database Administration, and Production Support. Strong hands-on expertise in Linux operating systems such as Red Hat Enterprise Linux (RHEL), CentOS, Oracle Linux, or similar platforms. title: Assistant Manager/Manager - Supply Operations (Food Platform)
description:
Job Description: Assistant Manager/Manager - Supply Operations (Food Platform) 
 Function: Supply Chain / Procurement - GBS Position location: Mumbai/Navi Mumbai
 
 Purpose of the Job The Assistant Manager - Supply Operations (Food Platform) coordinates day-to-day Food Platform Administration activities and ensures accurate, timely and compliant execution of defined system transactions supporting the Australian Food Platform.
The role executes and coordinates master data administration, purchase order generation, system administration, documentation and reporting within Microsoft Dynamics AX and future Enterprise Resource Planning (ERP) systems. It ensures activities are completed in accordance with approved Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs), work instructions and agreed Service Level Agreements (SLAs).
The position supports operational coordination between GBS Administration and the Australian Food Platform. It does not make operational, culinary, commercial or client decisions. Any activity outside documented procedures must be escalated to the Manager and the Australian Food Platform for direction.
 
 
 Context and Main Issues - The GBS Food Platform Administration team provides structured transactional support to the Australian Food Platform through approved systems and documented procedures. Accuracy of master data, ordering outputs and system transactions is essential to reliable purchasing, inventory planning and Food Platform operations. The role operates in a highly controlled environment where compliance with SOPs, work instructions, SLAs, quality checks and audit requirements is mandatory. The jobholder must coordinate assigned transactional activities, maintain service performance and support effective communication between GBS Administration and Australia. Operational, culinary, commercial and client decisions remain with the Australian Food Platform; exceptions or unclear instructions must be escalated promptly. The role is expected to support standardization, process improvement, system changes and automation while preserving governance, data integrity and documented approval controls. 
 
 Key Responsibilities & Assignments -Service Delivery Coordination 
 Coordinate assigned Food Platform Administration activities to achieve agreed quality, productivity and SLA targets. Monitor daily work queues, priorities and completion status; provide first-level troubleshooting and escalate unresolved issues to the Manager. Work effectively with Australian stakeholders and the Manager to resolve operational issues and implement approved changes. 
 Purchase Order Generation 
 Oversee preparation of purchase requisition requests, future costing orders, recalculation orders and defrost orders in line with approved SOPs. Ensure purchase order files are exported, renamed and retained in accordance with naming conventions and audit requirements. Ensure order templates are created only when instructed, outputs are validated before release, and system errors are escalated immediately. 
 Master Data Administration 
 Ensure accurate creation and maintenance of approved ING and REC master data, including mandatory fields, nutritional information, preparation yields, cooking yields and REC attributes. Oversee approved ING-to-IT linking, item relationship validation and unit conversion creation and maintenance. Maintain version control and system accuracy. No master data change may be made without documented approval from the Australian Food Platform. 
 Data Quality Assurance 
 Apply documented quality checks, validate mandatory fields and complete required validation checklists. Identify and correct data-entry errors, maintain data integrity and audit history, and escalate missing, conflicting or inconsistent information. 
 System Administration Support 
 Oversee routine administration of Food Platform systems, including active trade agreement records, approved system updates and scheduled tasks. Maintain system documentation, follow release procedures and escalate technical issues through the approved support channels. 
 Documentation Management 
 Maintain controlled templates, electronic filing structures and document version control. Archive superseded documents and ensure records comply with approved document-control procedures. 
 Reporting 
 Prepare and distribute approved operational reports to nominated stakeholders within agreed timelines. Validate report completeness and accuracy, and escalate anomalies identified during reporting. 
 Process Compliance & Risk Control 
 Ensure all activities follow approved SOPs, work instructions, quality-management requirements and service levels. Record exceptions, maintain evidence of completed controls and escalate activities that fall outside documented procedures. 
 Continuous Improvement 
 Identify repetitive administrative issues and recommend improvements to documented procedures. Participate in process reviews and User Acceptance Testing, and support implementation of approved process, system and automation improvements. 
 
 Accountabilities -Service Delivery Excellence:

 Master Data Accuracy & Integrity:

 Order Output Reliability:

 Process Compliance & Risk Management:

 Operational Capability:

 Continuous Improvement:

Experience working within structured administrative processes and managing delivery against defined procedures, quality measures and service levels. Experience maintaining electronic master data and working within enterprise business systems. Experience using Microsoft Excel for data validation, analysis and operational reporting. Experience coordinating stakeholders, escalations, work priorities and service delivery.

Experience working within Shared Services, Global Business Services or a multinational environment. Exposure to process improvement, system testing, transition or change-management initiatives.

 About the Role We are looking for an experienced Senior System Administrator to join our IT infrastructure team in Jaipur. The role will be responsible for providing advanced technical support across diverse, multi-tenant environments, handling escalated incidents, implementing complex infrastructure changes, and acting as a senior escalation point for the engineering team. 
 The ideal candidate will have strong expertise across Windows Server, Active Directory/Entra ID, Intune, Microsoft 365, Identity Management, Cloud, Networking, Security, and Automation , along with excellent troubleshooting and client communication skills. 
 Key Responsibilities 
 Take end-to-end technical ownership of assigned client environments and resolve infrastructure- and business-critical issues. Provide L3/third-level support and advanced troubleshooting for complex server, network, workstation, identity, and cloud issues. Lead major incidents, coordinate with internal teams, clients, and third-party vendors, and drive issues through resolution. Conduct Root Cause Analysis (RCA) and post-incident reviews while implementing corrective and preventive actions. Analyse recurring/systemic issues and develop permanent solutions to improve infrastructure reliability. Assess client infrastructure, applications, systems, and processes and recommend improvements, upgrades, and transformation initiatives. Design, implement, and validate solutions covering: 
 Hybrid Active Directory / Microsoft Entra ID Identity & Access Management Microsoft Intune and device management Conditional Access and Identity Governance Networking and Firewall policies Zero Trust architecture Disaster Recovery and business continuity SASE/SWG and SIEM integrations 
 Benchmark, tune, and optimise systems for performance, capacity, security, and scalability. Develop and maintain automation and operational tools using PowerShell , RMM policies, deployment pipelines, compliance checks, and monitoring solutions. Create and maintain technical documentation, network diagrams, knowledge base articles, and change management records. Review and approve complex technical changes in accordance with established processes and industry best practices. Mentor junior engineers, conduct technical knowledge sharing, and contribute to team readiness and process improvements. Maintain clear and professional communication with clients and stakeholders, including executive-level technical briefings. Participate in after-hours support and on-call rotations when required. 
 Required Skills & Qualifications 
 7 to 9 years of experience in IT infrastructure, system administration, or IT operations, preferably within an MSP or large enterprise environment . Strong hands-on expertise in: Windows Server Active Directory Microsoft Entra ID / Azure AD Microsoft Intune Microsoft 365 / Exchange Administration Identity & Access Management Cloud Infrastructure Networking & Firewalls 
 Strong understanding of hybrid identity, authentication, security, and enterprise infrastructure. Experience handling major incidents, escalations, infrastructure transformations, and complex troubleshooting. Strong PowerShell scripting and automation capabilities. Experience with security, disaster recovery, Zero Trust, Conditional Access, and identity governance. Excellent documentation, analytical, problem-solving, and time-management skills. Strong verbal and written communication skills with the ability to interact confidently with clients and senior stakeholders. Ability to work independently as well as collaboratively within a technical team. Strong customer service and stakeholder management skills. Willingness to participate in on-call/after-hours support as required. 
 Preferred Certifications

 Good to Have 
 Experience working in a Managed Service Provider (MSP) environment. Experience supporting multi-tenant client environments . Exposure to SASE/SWG and SIEM platforms. Experience working with RMM platforms and infrastructure monitoring tools. Willingness to travel to nearby client locations when required. 
 What We're Looking For We are looking for a technically strong and customer-focused professional who can own complex infrastructure problems, lead critical incidents, mentor engineers, and proactively improve client environments . 
 If you enjoy solving challenging infrastructure problems and working across Windows, Cloud, Identity, Networking, Security, and Automation , this role offers an excellent opportunity to work on diverse and technically challenging environments.

Automate provisioning, de-provisioning, reporting, compliance monitoring, and operational tasks. Create self-healing scripts and operational runbooks to improve service reliability. Monitoring & Reporting Establish monitoring standards and alerting mechanisms for AD and Entra ID services. Analyze and report on service performance, security posture, and availability metrics. Maintain architecture documentation, SOPs, knowledge articles, and recovery procedures. Incident, Problem & Change Management Act as final escalation point for L1 and L2 teams. Statutory Records & Documentation Maintain statutory registers and corporate records in accordance with applicable laws. Ensure all corporate records are accurate, updated, confidential, and readily available for audits/inspections. 6. Stakeholder & Advisory Responsibilities Coordinate with Directors, senior management, auditors, legal counsel, consultants, and regulatory authorities. Strong working knowledge of the Companies Act, 2013 , MCA/ROC compliance, Secretarial Standards, and corporate governance. Experience in handling actual Board Meetings, AGM, EGM, and other statutory meetings is mandatory . Strong communication and stakeholder-management skills. High attention to detail and ability to manage multiple statutory deadlines.
