title: Principal Software Engineer
description:
Role Overview 
 As a Principal Software Engineer for the Fluence OS platform, you will provide hands-on technical leadership for the design, development, integration, deployment and evolution of reliable edge-platform software used in industrial energy systems. You will combine deep Linux and container expertise with strong C/C++ engineering and practical knowledge of Industrial IoT communication protocols. The role is expected to solve complex cross-component problems, establish engineering direction and raise the technical capability of teams working across a globally distributed organization. 
 What You Will Do 
 Technical ownership and architecture: Own the technical design and evolution of major Fluence OS platform capabilities. Translate product and system requirements into scalable, maintainable software architecture and clear implementation plans. Hands-on platform engineering: Design, develop, integrate and troubleshoot production-grade software running on Ubuntu Linux, with a strong focus on C/C++, system services, resource efficiency, reliability and long-term maintainability. Containerized application delivery: Define and implement Docker-based packaging and runtime practices, including Dockerfiles, image construction, Docker Compose configurations, upgrades, observability and troubleshooting across deployed environments. Industrial communication: Lead the design and implementation of robust integrations using protocols such as MQTT, Modbus, BACnet and OPC UA. Address interoperability, data quality, performance, fault handling and recovery across heterogeneous industrial devices and systems. Gateway and industrial edge development: Design and develop software gateways and edge services that connect industrial devices, normalize and route data, perform protocol conversion, and operate reliably on embedded and industrial computing platforms. System integration and reliability: Diagnose complex issues spanning applications, operating systems, containers, networks, protocols and third-party open-source components. Drive root-cause analysis and sustainable corrective actions rather than short-term fixes. Engineering excellence: Set standards for code quality, code reviews, automated testing, secure development, performance analysis, observability, release readiness and technical documentation. CI/CD and automation: Guide improvements to build, test, package and deployment pipelines. Use scripting and automation to improve repeatability, traceability and engineering productivity. Technical leadership: Lead design reviews, challenge assumptions constructively, make well-reasoned technical decisions and mentor engineers. Provide clear direction while remaining deeply involved in implementation and problem solving. Cross-functional collaboration: Partner with product managers, architects, subject-matter experts, quality teams, site teams and other engineering groups to deliver platform outcomes in an agile, globally distributed environment. Documentation and knowledge sharing: Create architecture decisions, interface specifications, development standards, troubleshooting guidance and customer-facing technical documentation that are precise and usable. 
 Required Qualifications 8+ years of professional software engineering experience, including significant ownership of complex production software or platform components. Deep hands-on expertise with Ubuntu Linux, including services, processes, filesystems, permissions, package management, logging, networking and performance troubleshooting. Strong hands-on C/C++ programming skills, with experience designing, debugging and maintaining production-grade software. Advanced practical experience with Docker containers, including Dockerfiles, image creation, Docker Compose, networking, storage, upgrades and runtime troubleshooting. Strong working knowledge of Industrial IoT and industrial communication protocols, including several of MQTT, Modbus TCP/RTU, BACnet and OPC UA. Experience integrating software with industrial devices, gateways, controllers or other edge systems, with an understanding of unreliable networks and distributed-system failure modes. Experience with software architecture, interface design, design patterns, multithreading/concurrency, memory and resource management, and performance optimization. Experience with source control, code review, build systems, automated testing and CI/CD pipelines. Demonstrated ability to lead technical investigations, make architecture decisions and guide delivery across multiple engineers or teams. Excellent English communication skills, including concise technical writing and the ability to explain complex topics to technical and non-technical stakeholders. Hands-on experience developing industrial gateways, protocol converters or edge communication services that bridge field devices and higher-level platform applications. Experience developing, integrating and troubleshooting software on embedded Linux and industrial computing devices, including Advantech or comparable industrial PCs, controllers and gateways. Understanding of hardware-constrained and field-deployed environments, including device interfaces, serial and Ethernet communication, resource limitations, remote diagnostics and operational reliability. 
 Preferred Qualifications 
 Python and Bash scripting for automation, tooling, testing and diagnostics. Experience designing or maintaining CI/CD pipelines for C/C++ and containerized applications. Knowledge of IP networking, routing, DNS, TLS, certificates, firewalls and troubleshooting of field-network communication. Experience with observability and open-source platform components such as Grafana, time-series data systems, message brokers or monitoring tools. Experience with test automation, protocol simulators, hardware-in-the-loop testing or integration laboratories. Experience with cloud or hybrid edge environments, including AWS services such as EC2. Familiarity with Node.js/TypeScript, NestJS, PostgreSQL or related platform technologies. Experience in energy storage, SCADA, industrial automation, controls or another operational-technology domain. Familiarity with common embedded and industrial interfaces such as RS-232/RS-485, CAN, GPIO or other device-level communication interfaces. 
 Leadership Expectations 
 Operate as a senior technical authority who remains hands-on and accountable for engineering outcomes. Create clarity in ambiguous problem spaces and balance immediate delivery needs with platform sustainability. Mentor engineers through design feedback, code reviews, debugging support and practical knowledge sharing. Influence architecture and engineering practices across team boundaries through facts, prototypes and clear trade-off analysis. Promote a culture of quality, ownership, collaboration and continuous improvement. 
 Education 
 Bachelor's degree and a minimum of 12 years of related experience, or a Master's degree and 8 years of related experience, or a PhD and 5 years, or the equivalent

title: Senior Technical Project Manager
description:
SUMMARY 
 Job Summary 
 We are seeking a technically strong Senior Technical Project Manager to drive delivery of complex, technology-heavy projects for our retail-focused client portfolio. This role is weighted toward technical ownership and hands-on execution the ideal candidate is someone who can dig into code, architecture, and infrastructure decisions directly, not just track status. Deep working knowledge of Python, .NET, and cloud platforms (AWS/Azure/GCP) is essential, along with practical experience implementing modern deployment strategies (CI/CD, blue-green, canary releases) and a solid understanding of retail industry systems such as omnichannel commerce, POS, supply chain, and customer engagement platforms. 
 The Senior Technical Project Manager will be hands-on in reviewing architecture and code-level decisions, troubleshooting technical blockers, validating deployment pipelines, and ensuring solutions are technically sound using project management skills as a means to keep technical delivery on track, rather than as the core focus of the role. 
 
 Key Responsibilities 
 Own the technical delivery of projects end-to-end from solution design review through deployment for retail client engagements. 
 Get hands-on with Python and .NET codebases where needed: reviewing code quality, debugging issues, validating designs, and ensuring adherence to engineering best practices. 
 Evaluate and make recommendations on cloud architecture across AWS, Azure, and/or GCP compute, storage, networking, managed services, and cost optimization. 
 Design, implement, and troubleshoot deployment strategies and pipelines CI/CD (Jenkins, Azure DevOps, GitHub Actions, GitLab CI), containerization (Docker/Kubernetes), blue-green/canary releases, and infrastructure-as-code (Terraform/CloudFormation/ARM). 
 Perform technical risk assessments and gap analyses on architecture, integrations, and non-functional requirements (scalability, performance, security). 
 Translate business and functional requirements into detailed technical specifications and solution designs. 
 Set up and maintain project-level technical tracking (sprint boards, technical backlogs) using Jira, Azure DevOps, or similar tools, with a focus on technical accuracy over administrative reporting. 
 Serve as the technical point of contact for client engineering counterparts, resolving technical queries and unblocking implementation issues directly. 
 Evaluate and recommend appropriate cloud service offerings (IaaS, PaaS, SaaS) based on technical fit, scalability, and cost including proof-of-concept work where needed. 
 Embed DevSecOps practices into the SDLC security scanning, compliance checks, and governance gates within CI/CD pipelines. 
 Apply retail domain knowledge to solution design for e-commerce platforms, POS integration, inventory/order management, supply chain systems, and customer data platforms. 
 Contribute technical estimations, architecture diagrams, and solution approaches for proposals and pre-sales efforts. 
 Evaluate and pilot AI/automation tooling (agentic coding tools, LLM Ops, AI guardrails) to improve engineering efficiency and delivery quality. 
 Produce and maintain technical documentation architecture diagrams, deployment runbooks, integration specs, and technical decision logs. 
 Coordinate lightweight project logistics (timelines, dependencies, status updates) only to the extent needed to keep technical delivery unblocked this is not a resourcing/staff-management role. 
 
 Required Qualifications 
 Experience 
 12+ years of overall IT/engineering experience, with substantial hands-on time writing, reviewing, or architecting Python and/or .NET applications. 
 Strong, current working knowledge of cloud platforms (AWS, Azure, GCP) including compute (EC2/App Services/Compute Engine), storage, networking, serverless (Lambda/Azure Functions), and managed database services gained through direct implementation, not just oversight. 
 Hands-on experience designing and troubleshooting CI/CD pipelines and deployment strategies : Jenkins, Azure DevOps, GitHub Actions, or GitLab CI; containerization (Docker, Kubernetes); blue-green/canary releases; infrastructure-as-code (Terraform, CloudFormation, ARM templates). 
 Prior technical delivery experience within the retail domain e-commerce, POS, order management, supply chain, merchandising, or customer loyalty platforms strongly preferred. 
 Experience integrating and evaluating different cloud service offerings (IaaS/PaaS/SaaS) for fit, scalability, and cost. 
 Working knowledge of monitoring/observability tools (Datadog, New Relic, CloudWatch, Grafana) and hands-on incident/troubleshooting experience. 
 Practical exposure to AI/ML-driven tooling or automation frameworks in SDLC processes (e.g., agentic coding tools, LLM Ops, AI guardrails) is a strong plus. 
 Familiarity with Agile/Scrum delivery is expected, 
 Skills 
 Strong, practical command of Python and/or .NET : able to read, review, and reason about code, APIs, microservices, and integration patterns directly rather than through a manager's summary. 
 Solid grasp of cloud architecture across IaaS, PaaS, and SaaS models, with the ability to independently evaluate trade-offs and design options. 
 Deep understanding of software deployment and release management rollback strategies, zero-downtime deployments, and pipeline debugging. 
 Strong analytical and troubleshooting skills comfortable digging into logs, configs, and system behavior to diagnose root causes. 
 Ability to produce clear technical documentation (architecture diagrams, runbooks, technical specs) independently. 
 Working knowledge of security and compliance considerations relevant to retail/e-commerce (PCI-DSS, data privacy). 
 Clear technical communication skills for engaging with engineering teams and client technical counterparts this role is not focused on executive stakeholder management or team leadership. 
 Education 
 Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, or a related field. 
 Relevant certifications such as PMP, PMI-ACP, CSM, SAFe Agilist, AWS/Azure/GCP certifications (Solutions Architect, DevOps Engineer) are highly desirable. 
 
 Preferred Attributes 
 Prior consulting or IT services experience serving retail/fashion clients. 
 Experience with tooling strategy and SDLC process tracking. 
 Comfortable being the most technically hands-on person in the room prototyping, debugging, or reviewing designs directly rather than delegating. 
 A proactive, self-directed mindset with the ability to operate independently on technical problems in fast-paced, client-facing environments.

description:
About Position: 
 We are seeking an experienced SAP Project Manager to lead large-scale SAP implementation, migration, rollout, and transformation programs. The ideal candidate will be responsible for managing the complete SAP project lifecycle, ensuring successful delivery through effective planning, governance, stakeholder management, risk mitigation, and execution excellence. The role requires strong leadership capabilities, experience managing cross-functional SAP teams, and a proven track record of delivering complex SAP programs on time and within budget. 
 Role: SAP Project Manager Location: Pune Experience: 12 to 16 Years Job Type: Full-Time Employment 
 What You'll Do: 
 Lead SAP project delivery and support operations across multiple business functions and SAP modules. Manage SAP ECC environments with strong focus on APO, GTS, and related enterprise applications. Drive TSA Exit, carve-out, transition, and post-transition support activities. Coordinate with business users, IT teams, vendors, and leadership stakeholders to ensure smooth project execution. Prioritize project activities and ensure successful completion of milestones within agreed timelines. Manage and track project risks, dependencies, issues, and mitigation plans. Lead User Acceptance Testing (UAT) defect resolution activities and coordinate with cross-functional teams. Support cutover planning, deployment activities, hypercare support, and stabilization efforts. Establish and implement governance processes, project reporting, and operational controls. Ensure timely follow-up and resolution of support tickets and operational issues. Allocate tasks effectively across SAP teams and monitor overall service delivery performance. Collaborate with infrastructure, application, security, and business teams on SAP-related initiatives. Support SAP upgrades, enhancements, and business transformation programs. Drive process improvements to enhance operational efficiency and service quality. Develop and maintain strong relationships with senior business stakeholders and executive leadership. Ensure compliance with organizational standards, service level agreements, and governance frameworks. Mentor team members and provide technical and functional guidance when required. Support resource planning, capacity management, and team performance management activities. 
 Expertise You'll Bring: 
 12 to 16 years of experience in SAP Project Management, SAP Delivery Management, or SAP Program Management. Strong expertise across SAP ECC and enterprise SAP landscapes. Hands-on experience with SAP APO and SAP GTS implementations, enhancements, and support activities. Proven experience managing SAP carve-out, transition, TSA Exit, and stabilization projects. Strong leadership skills with experience managing large SAP teams and cross-functional stakeholders. Experience establishing and managing SAP Run Organizations and support models. Excellent understanding of SAP support processes, issue management, and operational governance. Strong business acumen with the ability to align SAP solutions to business objectives. Experience managing SAP users, roles, authorizations, and support operations. Strong project planning, execution, resource allocation, and risk management expertise. Experience working with executive leadership, business users, and global stakeholders. Proven ability to drive issue resolution, defect management, and continuous service improvement. Experience supporting SAP upgrades, migrations, and transformation initiatives. Strong analytical, troubleshooting, and decision-making capabilities. Excellent verbal and written communication skills. Ability to work effectively in complex and fast-paced enterprise environments. Strong focus on customer satisfaction, operational excellence, and delivery quality. 
 Benefits: 
 Competitive salary and benefits package Culture focused on talent development with quarterly growth opportunities and company-sponsored higher education and certifications Opportunity to work with cutting-edge technologies Employee engagement initiatives such as project parties, flexible work hours, and Long Service awards Annual health check-ups Insurance coverage: group term life, personal accident, and Mediclaim hospitalization for self, spouse, two children, and parents

title: Senior Civil Engineer
description:
Only Male Candidates from Pune, PCMC will be considered. Apllicants other than Pune (out of Pune city) will not be considered. 
 
 Position Senior Civil Engineer Department Projects / Construction Reporting To Site In-Charge / Project Manager Location PCMC & Nearby Areas, Pune Employment Type Full-Time 


 Preferred candidate locations - Ravet/Pimple Gurav/Bhosari/Chakan/Punawale/Moshi/Alandi/Charholi/PCMC and nearby areas only. 
 1. Job Purpose The Senior Civil Engineer will be responsible for assisting in the planning, execution, supervision, and monitoring of civil construction activities at project sites. The role requires strong knowledge of civil engineering principles, practical site execution skills, quality awareness, and the ability to coordinate effectively with contractors, subcontractors, consultants, vendors, and internal teams. 
 The candidate will ensure that construction work is executed safely, efficiently, and in accordance with approved drawings, specifications, quality standards, project schedules, and company requirements. 
 2. Key Responsibilities A. Site Supervision & Execution Supervise day-to-day civil construction activities at the assigned project site. Monitor construction activities including excavation, PCC, RCC, reinforcement, shuttering, masonry, plastering, waterproofing, flooring, tiling, painting, and other finishing works. Ensure work is executed as per approved drawings, specifications, and instructions from senior engineers. Check the availability and proper utilization of manpower, materials, tools, machinery, and equipment. Coordinate with contractors and subcontractors to ensure timely completion of assigned activities. Monitor the progress of work and report delays, site issues, and constraints to the reporting manager. Ensure proper sequencing of construction activities to avoid unnecessary delays and rework. B. Drawing & Technical Understanding Read and understand structural, architectural, civil, and service-related drawings. Verify dimensions, levels, alignments, locations, and other details before execution. Coordinate with senior engineers and consultants in case of discrepancies or missing information in drawings. Ensure that construction is carried out according to the latest approved drawings. Maintain proper records of drawings, revisions, instructions, and site-related documents. Assist in preparing basic quantity calculations and measurements from drawings. C. Quality Control Ensure that construction work complies with approved specifications and required quality standards. Check reinforcement, shuttering, concrete, masonry, plastering, waterproofing, and finishing work before proceeding to the next stage. Assist in checking the quality of incoming construction materials. Coordinate with the quality-control team for inspections and testing. Ensure proper curing of concrete and masonry work. Identify defective or substandard work and immediately report it to the concerned senior. Monitor rectification and ensure that rejected or defective work is corrected properly. Minimize material wastage and prevent unnecessary rework. D. Quantity & Measurement Assist in taking measurements of completed work executed by contractors. Prepare and maintain measurement records for civil works. Assist in checking contractor bills against actual site measurements. Verify quantities of materials consumed at the site. Assist in preparing basic BOQ quantities and material requirements. Maintain records of concrete, steel, cement, sand, blocks, tiles, and other construction materials. Monitor material consumption against approved quantities and identify unusual wastage. E. Material Management Coordinate with the stores and purchase departments regarding material requirements. Check materials received at site for quantity and basic quality requirements. Ensure materials are used appropriately and wastage is controlled. Inform the senior engineer about upcoming material requirements to avoid work stoppage. F. Contractor & Labour Coordination Coordinate with contractors, subcontractors, supervisors, and skilled/unskilled workers. Allocate daily work activities as instructed by senior engineers. Monitor labour productivity and work progress. Maintain discipline and proper coordination among site workers. Report manpower shortages and productivity issues to the reporting manager. Ensure workers understand the required quality and execution standards. Coordinate with contractors for timely completion of assigned targets. 
 G. Safety Compliance Follow and promote all safety rules and procedures at the construction site. Ensure workers use appropriate Personal Protective Equipment (PPE). Immediately report unsafe working conditions, accidents, near misses, and hazards. Ensure proper housekeeping and safe movement of workers and materials. Coordinate with the safety team to address site safety observations. Never compromise safety for speed or project deadlines. H. Daily Reporting & Documentation Prepare daily progress reports as required by the reporting manager. Record manpower deployment, material consumption, work progress, and major site activities. Maintain site photographs and progress documentation. Report any technical, manpower, material, quality, or coordination issues promptly. Maintain proper records of inspections, measurements, checklists, and site instructions. Assist senior engineers in preparing weekly and monthly project progress reports. 3. Coordination Responsibilities The Senior Civil Engineer will regularly coordinate with: Senior Civil Engineers Site In-Charge / Project Manager Architects Structural Consultants MEP Teams Quality Control Team Safety Team Purchase Department Stores Department Contractors & Subcontractors Vendors and Suppliers The candidate must maintain professional communication and ensure that instructions received from senior management are properly implemented at site. 
 4. Required Qualifications Education: B.E. / B.Tech./Diploma in Civil Engineering. Candidates with relevant site experience will be preferred. 
 Experience: 5-7 years of relevant experience in residential and commercial construction is preferred. 5. Required Technical Skills The candidate should have knowledge of: Civil construction practices RCC and structural work Reinforcement and shuttering Masonry and plastering Waterproofing Flooring and finishing works Quantity estimation and measurement Reading architectural and structural drawings Basic knowledge of AutoCAD MS Excel and MS Office Basic understanding of construction materials Quality control procedures Site safety practices
 
 6. Key Skills & Competencies Strong site supervision skills Good communication and coordination abilities Basic technical and problem-solving skills Ability to read and understand drawings Good numerical and measurement skills Attention to detail Ability to manage multiple activities simultaneously Teamwork and coordination Time management Willingness to work at construction sites Ability to work under pressure and meet deadlines Positive attitude and willingness to learn 
 7. Key Performance Indicators (KPIs) Performance will be evaluated based on: Timely completion of assigned work Quality of executed work Reduction in rework and material wastage Accuracy of measurements and documentation Contractor and labour coordination Compliance with drawings and specifications Safety compliance Daily/weekly reporting accuracy Productivity and utilization of resources Adherence to project schedules 8. Candidate Profile The ideal candidate should be a technically sound, hardworking, responsible, and career-oriented Civil Engineer who is willing to work at construction sites and learn practical aspects of project execution. The candidate must have a hands-on approach, good observation skills, and the ability to identify site-level problems and escalate them appropriately. Strong discipline, punctuality, professional conduct, and willingness to take responsibility will be highly valued. 9. Working Conditions The position is primarily site-based. The candidate may be required to travel to project locations within PCMC and nearby areas. The role involves regular interaction with contractors, labourers, vendors, consultants, and project teams. Working hours may vary depending on project requirements and critical construction activities. 10. Overall Responsibility The Senior Civil Engineer will play an important role in ensuring that assigned construction activities are completed on time, within required quality standards, with minimum wastage, and in accordance with approved drawings, specifications, safety requirements, and company policies. The position offers an opportunity to develop strong practical knowledge in construction execution, project coordination, quantity management, quality control, and overall site management while working under experienced senior engineering and project-management professionals .

title: Lead Engineer - Backend (Data Platform)
description:
About the Role We are looking for a Lead Engineer - Backend / Data Platform to provide technical leadership for backend and data-intensive systems powering analytics, reporting, experimentation, and behavioural insights across Wingify AB Tasty. This is a hands-on technical leadership role , not an engineering management position. You will continue to design systems and write production code , while also owning architecture and technical direction for significant workstreams. You will work across Java, ClickHouse, BigQuery, Bigtable, Redis, Kafka, and GCP , solving problems spanning event ingestion, distributed processing, query engines, analytical storage, low-latency serving, and reporting. A key part of the role is helping us evolve two mature analytics platforms toward a more unified data foundation without compromising the reliability of systems already serving production customers. 
The Engineering Landscape Our production data platform includes: ClickHouse - self-hosted and ClickHouse Cloud for high-volume analytics and SaaS reporting BigQuery - large-scale analytics and data processing Bigtable - low-latency NoSQL serving Redis - caching, queues, and distributed coordination Kafka - high-volume real-time event streaming GCP - GCS, Pub/Sub, Dataflow, IAM, Secret Manager, GKE and VMs Java - Spring Boot and JVM-based backend services Apache Beam / Dataflow - distributed event and batch processing Go - adjacent SQL and reporting services Alongside the existing platform, we are building capabilities around: Warehouse-native experiment computation in customer Snowflake/BigQuery environments Cross-platform visitor profiles and identity First-party cohorts and saved audiences Unified metrics across internal and customer warehouses Converging Wingify and AB Tasty analytics onto a common data foundation 
What Youll Do Architecture System Design Own the technical architecture and design of significant backend/data-platform workstreams. Design distributed systems for high-volume event ingestion, analytical querying, data processing, and low-latency serving . Make architectural decisions around data modelling, storage engines, partitioning, query patterns, caching, streaming, reliability, and cost . Evaluate trade-offs across ClickHouse, BigQuery, Bigtable, Redis, Kafka, and other technologies based on workload characteristics. Drive designs that can evolve as the Wingify and AB Tasty platforms converge. Hands-on Engineering Remain hands-on with Java and production backend code . Build and evolve backend services, query engines, APIs, data pipelines, and distributed processing systems. Write and optimise complex analytical SQL and troubleshoot performance bottlenecks. Solve difficult production problems involving slow queries, data correctness, pipeline failures, latency, throughput, and infrastructure . Work with Kafka, Pub/Sub, Dataflow, GCS, ClickHouse, BigQuery, Bigtable, and Redis at production scale. Own critical systems through design, implementation, deployment, observability, and operation . Technical Leadership Set technical direction for a platform area or major engineering workstream . Break ambiguous product and platform requirements into clear technical designs and execution plans. Review architecture and designs from other engineers and challenge assumptions constructively. Establish engineering practices around reliability, scalability, observability, performance, and maintainability . Mentor SSE-1/SSE-2 engineers and help them grow their system-design and production-engineering capabilities. Partner closely with Product, Engineering, Data, and Infrastructure teams. Influence architecture beyond your immediate projects without requiring formal people-management authority. 
What Were Looking For 6+ years of hands-on backend/software engineering experience , with substantial experience building distributed or data-intensive systems. Demonstrated ownership of architecture and system design for production systems at meaningful scale. Strong hands-on Java experience, including modern Java and JVM backend systems. Strong experience designing systems around analytical databases, data warehouses, and/or large-scale non-relational stores . Deep understanding of data modelling, partitioning, indexing, clustering, query execution, caching, concurrency, and performance optimisation . Strong SQL and analytical-querying experience. Experience designing and operating streaming/event-driven architectures , ideally using Kafka or equivalent technologies. Experience building batch and/or streaming data pipelines at scale. Strong cloud engineering experience; GCP is preferred. Experience operating production systems with clear SLOs, observability, failure handling, and performance requirements . Strong debugging ability across applications, distributed systems, databases, pipelines, and infrastructure. Experience mentoring senior engineers, reviewing technical designs, and influencing architecture . Ability to balance long-term platform architecture with pragmatic delivery. 
Nice to Have Deep production experience with ClickHouse , including schema design, MergeTree engines, partitioning, sorting keys, query optimisation, replication, and performance tuning. BigQuery and Bigtable at significant production scale. Apache Beam / Dataflow . Snowflake or warehouse-native compute architectures. Go , Vert.x, or other high-performance backend technologies. Experience handling billions of events and/or TB-PB scale analytical datasets . Experience with experimentation platforms, A/B testing, funnels, segmentation, identity resolution, cohorts, or behavioural analytics. Kubernetes, Docker, CI/CD, Prometheus, Grafana, or GCP Cloud Monitoring. 
Core Skills Java System Design Distributed Systems Data Platform ClickHouse SQL BigQuery Bigtable Kafka Redis GCP Pub/Sub Dataflow ETL Microservices Technical Leadership
